messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

A customer brings in a defective computer and the CRS checks the defect and hands out a repair cost calculation back. If the customer decides that the costs are acceptable, the process continues, otherwise she takes her computer home unrepaired. The ongoing repair consists of two activities, which are executed, in an arbitrary order. The first activity is to check and repair the hardware, whereas the second activity checks and configures the software. After each of these activities, the proper system functionality is tested. If an error is detected another arbitrary repair activity is executed, otherwise the repair is finished.

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
             xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
             xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
             xmlns:omgdc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
             xmlns:omgdi="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
             id="Definitions_1"
             targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">

  <collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <participant id="Participant_CRS" name="Computer Repair Service (CRS)" processRef="Process_CRS"/>

    <messageFlow id="MF_1" name="Defective Computer" sourceRef="Task_SendComputer" targetRef="StartEvent_CRS"/>
    <messageFlow id="MF_2" name="Repair Cost Calculation" sourceRef="Task_SendCostCalc" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCostCalc"/>
    <messageFlow id="MF_3" name="Customer Decision" sourceRef="Task_SendDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <messageFlow id="MF_4" name="Repaired Computer Notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveNotification"/>
  </collaboration>

  <!-- ================= CUSTOMER PROCESS ================= -->
  <process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">

    <startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer" name="Defective computer identified">
      <outgoing>Flow_C1</outgoing>
    </startEvent>

    <sendTask id="Task_SendComputer" name="Bring defective computer to CRS">
      <incoming>Flow_C1</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_C2</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCostCalc" name="Receive repair cost calculation">
      <incoming>Flow_C2</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_C3</outgoing>
    </receiveTask>

    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CostsOK" name="Costs acceptable?">
      <incoming>Flow_C3</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_C4_Yes</outgoing>
      <outgoing>Flow_C5_No</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <sendTask id="Task_SendDecision" name="Confirm repair acceptance">
      <incoming>Flow_C4_Yes</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_C6</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <endEvent id="EndEvent_Unrepaired" name="Take computer home unrepaired">
      <incoming>Flow_C5_No</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveNotification" name="Receive repaired computer notification">
      <incoming>Flow_C6</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_C7</outgoing>
    </receiveTask>

    <endEvent id="EndEvent_Collected" name="Computer collected">
      <incoming>Flow_C7</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="Task_SendComputer"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SendComputer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCostCalc"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCostCalc" targetRef="Gateway_CostsOK"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CostsOK" targetRef="Task_SendDecision"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CostsOK" targetRef="EndEvent_Unrepaired"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_SendDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveNotification"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveNotification" targetRef="EndEvent_Collected"/>

  </process>

  <!-- ================= CRS PROCESS ================= -->
  <process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS" isExecutable="false">

    <startEvent id="StartEvent_CRS" name="Computer received">
      <outgoing>Flow_R1</outgoing>
    </startEvent>

    <task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect">
      <incoming>Flow_R1</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R2</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="Task_CalcCost" name="Calculate repair costs">
      <incoming>Flow_R2</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R3</outgoing>
    </task>

    <sendTask id="Task_SendCostCalc" name="Send repair cost calculation">
      <incoming>Flow_R3</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R4</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive customer decision">
      <incoming>Flow_R4</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R5</outgoing>
    </receiveTask>

    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DecisionCheck" name="Repair accepted?">
      <incoming>Flow_R5</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R6_Accepted</outgoing>
      <outgoing>Flow_R7_Declined</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <endEvent id="EndEvent_Declined" name="Repair declined">
      <incoming>Flow_R7_Declined</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <parallelGateway id="Gateway_SplitRepair" name="Split repair tasks">
      <incoming>Flow_R6_Accepted</incoming>
      <incoming>Flow_R_Loop</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R8_HW</outgoing>
      <outgoing>Flow_R9_SW</outgoing>
    </parallelGateway>

    <task id="Task_RepairHW" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <incoming>Flow_R8_HW</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R10_HW</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="Task_TestHW" name="Test system functionality (HW)">
      <incoming>Flow_R10_HW</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R11_HW</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="Task_RepairSW" name="Check and configure software">
      <incoming>Flow_R9_SW</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R10_SW</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="Task_TestSW" name="Test system functionality (SW)">
      <incoming>Flow_R10_SW</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R11_SW</outgoing>
    </task>

    <parallelGateway id="Gateway_JoinRepair" name="Join repair tasks">
      <incoming>Flow_R11_HW</incoming>
      <incoming>Flow_R11_SW</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R12</outgoing>
    </parallelGateway>

    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorDetected" name="Error detected?">
      <incoming>Flow_R12</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R_Loop</outgoing>
      <outgoing>Flow_R13_NoError</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <task id="Task_FinishRepair" name="Finish repair">
      <incoming>Flow_R13_NoError</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R14</outgoing>
    </task>

    <sendTask id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify customer: computer ready">
      <incoming>Flow_R14</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_R15</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <endEvent id="EndEvent_RepairComplete" name="Repair process complete">
      <incoming>Flow_R15</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CRS" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_CalcCost"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R3" sourceRef="Task_CalcCost" targetRef="Task_SendCostCalc"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R4" sourceRef="Task_SendCostCalc" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_DecisionCheck"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R6_Accepted" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_DecisionCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SplitRepair"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R7_Declined" name="Declined" sourceRef="Gateway_DecisionCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_Declined"/>

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R8_HW" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitRepair" targetRef="Task_RepairHW"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R9_SW" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitRepair" targetRef="Task_RepairSW"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R10_HW" sourceRef="Task_RepairHW" targetRef="Task_TestHW"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R10_SW" sourceRef="Task_RepairSW" targetRef="Task_TestSW"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R11_HW" sourceRef="Task_TestHW" targetRef="Gateway_JoinRepair"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R11_SW" sourceRef="Task_TestSW" targetRef="Gateway_JoinRepair"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R12" sourceRef="Gateway_JoinRepair" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R_Loop" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="Gateway_SplitRepair"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R13_NoError" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="Task_FinishRepair"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R14" sourceRef="Task_FinishRepair" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_R15" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="EndEvent_RepairComplete"/>

  </process>

  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_1">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_1" bpmnElement="Collaboration_1">
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>

</definitions>
```
